faq.accounts.areTheseProvidersAffiliated: This is still a community-curated list and SoulFire does not own or operate these providers. Partner, official integration, and affiliate relationships are labeled on the page.
Are these providers affiliated with SoulFire?
faq.accounts.whatAreMfaAccounts.answer: MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication) accounts are permanent Minecraft accounts with full access. In alt-shop terms, they are the closest match to full-access Minecraft alts because you can change the email, password, and username. They're more secure and stable, which makes them pricier. Learn more in the {guide}.
faq.accounts.whatAreMfaAccounts.question: What are MFA accounts?
faq.accounts.whatAreNfaAccounts.answer: NFA (Non-Full Access) accounts are temporary Minecraft alts that may stop working over time. They're cheaper but come with a higher risk of losing access. See the {guide} for details on supported account types.
faq.accounts.whatAreNfaAccounts.question: What are NFA accounts?
faq.accounts.whatAreTemporaryMinecraftAl: When people search for temporary Minecraft alts, they usually mean NFA accounts or token and cookie-based accounts. These are cheaper than MFA or full-access accounts, but access can expire or stop working over time.
faq.accounts.whatAreTokenAndCookieAccoun: Token and cookie accounts are common delivery formats for lower-cost Minecraft alts. SoulFire supports refresh token, cookie, and access token auth for compatible NFA providers.
What are token and cookie accounts?
faq.accounts.whatDoesSfaMean.answer: In community jargon, SFA usually means Semi Full Access. The term is inconsistent across alt shops and some marketplaces treat it as misleading, so SoulFire uses the clearer MFA/full-access and NFA/temporary labels instead.
faq.accounts.whatDoesSfaMean.question: What does SFA mean?
faq.accounts.whatDoesTheFreeBadgeMean.an: Providers with the Free badge offer accounts at no cost. These are typically temporary tokens with daily limits.
faq.accounts.whichAccountTypeWorksWithSo: MFA accounts are fully supported by SoulFire. For NFA accounts, SoulFire supports refresh token, cookie, and access token auth. Read the {guide} for setup instructions.
Which account type works with SoulFire?
faq.commonQuestionsAboutProxiesForSoulfi: Common questions about proxies for SoulFire
faq.proxies.areTheseAffiliateLinks.answe: Yes, some links are affiliate links. Purchases through them help fund SoulFire development at no extra cost to you.
faq.proxies.canIUseFreeProxiesWithSoulfi: Some providers like Webshare offer a free tier. Free public proxy lists are not recommended since they're slow, unreliable, and often already blocked.
Can I use free proxies with SoulFire?
faq.proxies.whatDoesUnlimitedBandwidthMe: Some providers don't charge per GB of data transferred. This is useful for long-running bot sessions that generate lots of traffic.
faq.proxies.whatTypeOfProxyShouldIUse.an: Residential proxies are the hardest to detect but cost more. Datacenter proxies are faster and cheaper but easier to block. ISP proxies offer a middle ground. See the {guide} for recommendations.
faq.proxies.whatTypeOfProxyShouldIUse.qu: What type of proxy should I use?
faq.proxies.whyDoINeedProxiesForSoulfire: When running multiple bots, servers may block your IP. Proxies give each bot a different IP address, avoiding rate limits and IP bans. Learn more in the {guide}.
Why do I need proxies for SoulFire?
